summary: Excellent, comprehensive specification covering all required espionage formulas. The document includes: (1) spy success rate formula with racial/tech/security modifiers, (2) sabotage effects with destruction percentages for factories and missile bases, (3) tech theft probability with tier-based modifiers, (4) spy death chance formula with mission risk levels, and (5) counter-espionage mechanics including detection, spy hunts, and double agents. All JSON data tables are valid and implementation-ready. The pseudocode algorithm in Section 11 provides a complete mission resolution flow. Minor issues are cosmetic and do not impact implementation. Fully meets spec-017 requirements.
